title: Study First Info CRM
desc: A custom student enrollment CRM designed to eliminate manual tracking, optimize conversion pipelines, and automate counselor interactions in real-time.
imageAlt: Study First Info CRM Dashboard Interface
challenge: A major educational consultancy was losing up to 40% of potential leads due to fragmented manual Excel sheets, delayed counselor responses, and zero automation in follow-ups.
blueprint: We designed a multi-channel cloud CRM system featuring automatic lead capture from web forms, immediate automated WhatsApp and email outreach sequences, and a dynamic Kanban pipeline for counselor tracking.
execution: Built and deployed in 10 weeks, incorporating detailed role-based access controls and custom reporting dashboards. Transitioned the advisory team with zero data loss or operational interruptions.

title: HealthSakhi AI
desc: An AI-powered vernacular voice and text assistant enabling rural populations to pre-screen medical symptoms and connect with qualified local doctors.
challenge: Substantial shortages of rural medical personnel led to overcrowded central clinics, with patients travelling hours only to find trivial issues or delayed critical diagnoses.
blueprint: We architected an offline-resilient mobile web assistant powered by fine-tuned local language models and voice-to-text translators, integrated with a lightweight clinic-locator API.
execution: Integrated regional dialect models (Hindi, Marathi, etc.) with strict medical boundary guardrails. Conducted pilot programs with healthcare workers on-ground to refine the conversational UX.

title: PGX Payment Gateway
desc: An ultra-low latency intelligent payment routing gateway built to handle heavy transactional surges with automated instant retry mechanism.
challenge: High cart abandonment rates during gaming flash sales occurred because traditional payment processors failed to scale under high-concurrency requests.
blueprint: We built a concurrent Go gateway using a Redis-backed queue and distributed locking, capable of dynamic multi-acquirer transaction routing and smart retries.
execution: Implemented custom lightweight API SDKs for seamless client-side checkouts, scaling infrastructure with auto-healing load balancers on AWS ECS.

title: PlayGroundX Platform
desc: A unified Web3 gaming and tournament platform removing blockchain complexity with gasless transaction layers and social/email onboarding.
challenge: High barriers of entry, including Web3 wallet setups, gas token acquisitions, and complex contract signatures, deterred typical Web2 gamers from joining tournament structures.
blueprint: Designed a hybrid Next.js portal utilizing Account Abstraction smart contracts (ERC-4337) to sponsor gas fees, allowing instant social login wallet generation.
execution: Created decentralized tournament smart contracts on EVM-compatible networks, optimized for millisecond-accurate match validation and automatic payout distributions.

title: Turf Booking SaaS
desc: A multi-tenant SaaS booking platform enabling sports arenas to coordinate schedules, offer real-time bookings, and implement dynamic demand pricing.
challenge: Sports turf owners suffered regular revenue loss from double-booking disputes, unoptimized quiet slots, and the friction of manually collecting split payments from players.
blueprint: Constructed a multi-tenant platform with Supabase backend and Prisma-driven Postgres schema, implementing real-time calendar updates via WebSockets and automated billing integrations.
execution: Designed client dashboard and booking engine, adding a feature that dynamically discounts off-peak time slots and lets groups split payment shares directly.
